name: The Descent
author: Second Credit
description: Eight caves, each deeper than the last: rockfalls, fireflies, butterflies, a magic mill, the green tide, a labyrinth, and the heart of the mountain.

intro.title: The Descent
intro.text:
The old miners said the mountain glows at its heart, and that it keeps what it is given.
You have a lamp, a shovel and three tries. Start where the light still reaches.

story.title: The Rockfall
story.text:
Below First Light the ceiling was never shored up. Boulders sit stacked to the roof, waiting for someone to take the one at the bottom.
Dig from the side. Never from below.

story.title: Firefly Hollow
story.text:
Something glows in the tunnels here, and it is not the gems. The fireflies follow the walls and burn whatever they touch.
Let them pass. They always come round again.

story.title: Butterfly Garden
story.text:
Deeper down the air turns warm and soft, and butterflies drift in their brick cages.
The miners had a cruel trick: drop a boulder on one and it bursts into diamonds.

story.title: The Magic Mill
story.text:
A wall that shimmers like oil on water. Whatever falls through it comes out changed: stone into diamond, diamond into stone.
It only turns for a little while once it starts. Be ready.

story.title: The Green Tide
story.text:
The amoeba lives in the damp caves, and it grows. Leave it room and it chokes the cave in stone.
Fence it in, and it gives up its diamonds instead.

story.title: Glass Labyrinth
story.text:
Corridors of red brick fold back on themselves until the lamp light cannot tell left from right.
The gems are easy here. The clock is not.

story.title: The Deep Heart
story.text:
At the bottom the whole mountain hums. Every trick it has shown you is here at once, around the heart of it.
Take what you need, and find the way out.

outro.title: Daylight
outro.text:
You climb out into a grey morning with your pockets full and your lamp nearly dry.
Behind you, far down, the mountain glows a little dimmer. Or perhaps it is only your eyes.
